title: SLO orchestration and region-fallback visibility work
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Goal: provide an operational plane that ties token-level latency SLIs to automated SLO orchestration and multi-region failover decisions, while exposing a single set of dashboards for on-call and SRE. Scope: instrument golden signals at token granularity, add SLI derivations (p50/p95/p99 token-latency, token throughput, token error-rate), implement a circuit-breaker policy matrix that drives regional fallback and adaptive load-shedding, and build a set of Grafana panels and runbooks for incident response. Key constraints: keep metric cardinality bounded (labels limited to region, model_family, route), use HDR histograms for fine-grained token latency quantiles, and ensure SLI computation is compatible with both streaming and non-streaming responses. Deliverables: metrics schema, ingestion pipeline adjustments, SLI query definitions, alert rules, Grafana dashboard JSON, RBAC for dashboards, and a short runbook with escalation steps.
acceptance_criteria: Token-level latency SLI (p95 and p99) computed and visible in Grafana for each region and model_family
Circuit-breaker policy table implemented in control plane and exercising region-fallback through canary test
Load-shedding metric exposed (tokens_shed / tokens_received) and correlated with queue depth and CPU/GPU headroom
Dashboards include: regional headroom heatmap, per-route token latency waterfall, circuit-breaker state timeline, and adaptive-shed rate chart
Alerts: SLO burn-rate and imminent-SLO-violation paged to SRE; failover executed automatically in staging and manually reviewable in prod
Runbook updated with playbook steps, rollback instructions, and GitHub PR links
tasks: Define metric names and label set; add to metrics spec (metrics.md)
Implement HDR histogram export from runtime (tokens.latency.histogram)
Add SLI aggregation jobs in metrics pipeline (BigQuery/PrometheusX)
Implement circuit-breaker evaluation service and policy matrix in control plane
Author Grafana dashboards and add to dashboards repo
Create canary job to simulate regional outage and validate failover
Write runbook and schedule SRE tabletop exercise
comments: 2025-02-12 Maya Thompson: Initial triage complete. This ticket consolidates previous token-sli work into a single orchestration flow that can trigger region failover. Priority set to P0 due to repeated customer incidents tied to regional tail latency.

2025-02-13 Lucas Park: Design decision: use HDR histograms emitted per request shard to capture token-level quantiles without exploding metric series. Will retain labels: region, model_family, route. Trade-off: loses per-customer signature but keeps cardinality low.

2025-02-14 Diego Rivera (Design): Reviewed dashboard wireframes in Confluence. Request: add a compact per-route waterfall that stacks upstream queuing vs decode time. Marked up Confluence doc with layout suggestions.

2025-02-15 Anika Rao (PM): Confirmed SLO targets for experiments: p95_token_latency < 120ms for short-form routes, p99 < 400ms. Approved burn-rate alert thresholds. Asked that alerts be routed to reliability escalation policy and not next-gen paging until after smoke tests.

2025-02-17 Lucas Park: Prototype PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/3456. PR adds tokens.latency.histogram exporter, and new Prometheus job to scrape aggregated HDR buckets. Includes unit tests for histogram serialization.

2025-02-18 Ops run: smoke tests in staging passed. Canary failover exercised using test harness (k8s node pool cordon) and circuit-breaker executed fallback to secondary region after configured thresholds. Observed shed rate increasing as expected under synthetic spike.

2025-02-19 Diego Rivera: Design review completed on dashboard mock. Feedback applied: reduce color saturation on heatmap panels, add compact legend for circuit-breaker states, include notes about expected baseline in panel descriptions.

2025-02-20 Lucas Park: Preparing alert rules and runbook draft. Next: apply dashboard JSON to prod-readonly and schedule tabletop on 2025-02-27. Need SRE signoff before enabling automatic failover in prod.
notes: Sampling: for full trace sampling keep at 1% of requests to avoid trace storage blowup; histogram emission is full (no sampling).

Circuit-breaker policy matrix: primary triggers are region_token_error_rate, region_p99_token_latency, and token_queue_length. Each trigger has a severity band and corresponding action (alert, soft-shed, hard-shed, failover).

We will run a two-week canary where automatic failover is enabled only for internal traffic. After 1 week of stable metrics, enable for low-traffic customer-tier. Full prod enable requires SRE signoff.
